name: 21797 · Woodbine, MD
findings: ZIP 21797 (Woodbine) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21797 (Woodbine) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
